repo.captions.py:
"""Labels for trades."""


def label_trades(names, trades):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> volume dict and one 'name: volume' line per trade."""
    pairs = zip(names, (x.volume for x in trades))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines


def name_list(names):
    """Return the names joined by commas."""
    return ", ".join(names)


def largest_volume(trades):
    """Return the largest volume, or None when there are no trades."""
    values = [x.volume for x in trades]
    return max(values) if values else None

from trades import load_trades, ROWS
from captions import label_trades

NAMES = ["n%d" % i for i in range(len(ROWS))]


def test_lines_present():
    lookup, lines = label_trades(NAMES, load_trades())
    assert len(lines) == len(ROWS)


def test_lookup():
    lookup, lines = label_trades(NAMES, load_trades())
    assert lookup["n0"] == ROWS[0][1]
